description: This file exports an asynchronous function 'getCountryFromIP' that takes an IP address as input, performs an API call to 'ip-api.com' to retrieve geographic information, and returns the country name with a flag emoji. It handles error cases gracefully by returning 'Unknown'.

methods.name: getCountryFromIP
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches geographic info for an IP and returns country with flag emoji, or 'Unknown' on failure.
